    The push-down action of a path as a sum over its lifts #

    For a quiver morphism p : D → Q and a representation X of D, a word l of Q acts on the push-down p_*X as the sum of the operators of all lists of arrows of D labelled by l (Rep.pdAct_word_eq_sum); lists that are not paths act by zero (Rep.pathTot_eq_zero).
